outcome: Neonatal outcomes (gestational age, birth weight, Apgar scores, neonatal death)
cohort: 64 women who gave birth after renal transplantation in Israel between 1996 and 2011
finding: Patients who have undergone renal transplantation can safely undergo labor and obstetric analgesia with no reported anesthetic complications.
mod_finding: This study found that 47% of women after renal transplant had a vaginal delivery while 53% had a cesarean section.
